description.text:
The Fire deck (火属性对战卡组) is one of the eight decks of the Battle Party Set. Its Pokémon are Charizard & Braixen-GX, Charmander, Charmeleon, Charizard, Charizard-GX, Entei, Volcanion and Tauros. Its cards are numbered out of 25, and its Fire Energy is unnumbered.

The Battle Party Set (对战派对组合) came out on 15 April 2023: a box of eight ready-made 60-card decks, one each for Grass, Fire, Water, Lightning, Psychic, Fighting, Darkness and Metal, built from cards released up to Striking Competition, for eight players to battle with straight away. Each deck came as three 20-card packs. Every copy of a deck has the same cards, but some boxes had holo packs, the same cards in holo finish. At first the box could only be played at Battle Party events in gyms and partner shops, where each player drew a deck at random; it went on sale in shops on 1 February 2024.
